:::{#cor-bernoulli-loglik-contribution-logodds}
#### Log-likelihood contribution of one binary outcome in terms of the log-odds

If $\Outvar_\iobs \sim \Ber(\prob)$ has observed value $\outvar_\iobs \in \cb{0, 1}$,
its [log-likelihood](#def-loglik) contribution is, with the [log-odds](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-odds) $\logodds \eqdef \logit(\prob)$:

$$\llik_\iobs(\prob) = \outvar_\iobs \logodds + \logf{1 - \prob}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-bernoulli-loglik-contribution-logodds, worked in @sol-bernoulli-loglik-contribution-logodds.
It follows from @thm-bernoulli-loglik-contribution.
Summing over $\iobs$ gives @thm-bernoulli-loglik-one-group.

:::
